metadata.description: An atomic vibe-coding harness for AI agents. Tests ensure the installer creates a self-contained system without polluting the project.

features.description: Installer creates .agent directory structure in target project
steps: Run the installer via curl in a test project directory
Verify .agent/ directory is created
Confirm .agent/scripts/ contains all automation scripts
Confirm .agent/protocols/ contains agent instruction files
Confirm .agent/docs/ contains documentation files
Verify NO scripts/ directory is created at project root

features.description: Installer copies atomic wrapper script to project root
steps: Run the installer in a test project
Verify 'atomic' file exists at project root
Confirm atomic file is executable (has +x permission)
Run './atomic' with no args and verify help text displays
Verify help text shows available commands

features.description: Installer does not create or modify project scripts directory
steps: Create a test project with existing scripts/ directory
Add a dummy script to scripts/ to verify it's not touched
Run the Atomic Vibes installer
Verify the dummy script still exists unchanged
Confirm NO new files were added to scripts/
Verify all Atomic Vibes scripts are in .agent/scripts/ only
Create .agent/ directory in test project
Run installer and choose to re-initialize when prompted
Verify installer completes successfully
Confirm all required files are present in .agent/
Check that installer warns about existing .agent/ before proceeding

features.description: Git hooks are installed for test immutability
steps: Run installer in a git repository
Verify .githooks/pre-commit file exists
Confirm pre-commit hook is executable
Run './atomic install-hooks' to install hooks
Verify .git/hooks/pre-commit links to .githooks/pre-commit

features.description: Boot-up ritual displays Atomic Vibes branding
steps: Install Atomic Vibes in a test project
Run './atomic boot-up'
Verify output shows '⚛️ Atomic Vibes' header
Confirm output does NOT say 'Atomic Implementation System'
Check that all sections display properly formatted

features.description: Boot-up validates environment and shows status
steps: Run './atomic boot-up' in installed project
Verify it reads protocols from .agent/protocols/
Confirm it shows current state from .agent/state/current-state.json
Check that it validates git repository status
Verify it completes without errors

features.description: Atomic wrapper provides clean CLI for all commands
steps: Run './atomic' with no arguments
Verify help text displays with list of commands
Test './atomic boot-up' executes boot-up script
Test './atomic checks' executes run-checks script
Test './atomic new-feature TEST-001 desc' creates feature branch
Confirm all commands work without direct .agent/scripts/ paths

features.description: Run checks validates test immutability first
steps: Run './atomic checks'
Verify step 0 validates test immutability
Confirm validation runs before lint/build/test
Check that checks abort if test validation fails
Verify all check results are displayed clearly

features.description: Checks update state automatically after running
steps: Run './atomic checks'
Wait for checks to complete
Verify .agent/state/current-state.json is updated
Confirm buildStatus, lintStatus, testStatus reflect check results
Check that lastUpdated timestamp is current

features.description: State file is not committed to git
steps: Run './atomic boot-up' to create state
Run 'git status' in the project
Verify .agent/state/current-state.json is listed as untracked
Confirm .gitignore excludes .agent/state/
Check that .agent/logs/ is also gitignored

features.description: Protocol files are accessible and properly located
steps: Verify .agent/protocols/CLAUDE.md exists
Verify .agent/protocols/AGENT_README.md exists
Verify .agent/protocols/agent-protocol.md exists
Confirm all protocol files are committed (not gitignored)
Check that documentation is referenced correctly in README

features.description: Test validation prevents modification of test steps
steps: Create a feature-requirements.json with test features
Modify a test step (not just 'passes' field)
Run './atomic validate-tests' or './atomic checks'
Verify validation fails and shows error message
Confirm error explains that only 'passes' can be modified

features.description: Test validation allows updating passes field
steps: Create a feature-requirements.json with test features
Change a test's 'passes' field from false to true
Run './atomic validate-tests'
Verify validation passes without errors
Confirm the change is allowed

features.description: System is fully self-contained in .agent directory
steps: Install Atomic Vibes in a test project
List all files at project root
Verify ONLY 'atomic' and 'feature-requirements.json' are added
Confirm NO scripts/, NO CLAUDE.md, NO AGENT_README.md at root
Verify everything else is in .agent/ directory

features.description: Installation does not modify project README
steps: Create a test project with existing README.md
Note the README.md content
Install Atomic Vibes
Verify README.md is unchanged
Confirm installer does NOT copy any README to project root

features.description: System can be completely removed from project
steps: Install Atomic Vibes in a test project
Note original project files
Remove .agent/ directory and atomic script
Remove feature-requirements.json if it was added by installer
Verify project is back to original state with no Atomic Vibes artifacts
